sources.snippet: This directory contains conversion and inference examples for Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 vision-language models. Both use the same Bridge architecture; replace the Qwen3.5 model ID with Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B to run those paths for Qwen3.6. For model introduction and architecture details, see the Qwen3.5/3.6-VL documentation.

sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3.5-Omni, the latest advancement in the Qwen-Omni model family. Representing a significant evolution over its predecessor, Qwen3.5-Omni scales to hundreds of billions of parameters and supports a 256k context length.
